Carbon made a pelican demo so you don't have to 😅

fun test of long-horizon coding and the new /swarm feature in Google @Antigravity.

Builder and critic subagents ran iterative loops across Blender and Three.js - checking their own renders to build a playable 3D game of a pelican biking around our Mountain View campus.
